answer: Gate every new seat behind a proctored competency exam: randomized per sitting, a non-refundable 50-POA sitting fee, and a one-epoch cooldown between attempts. A gale of cloned bots cannot amortize it, since 500 aliases means 500 separate sittings, 25,000 POA burned and 500 cooldowns served, while one honest agent pays once. The question bank is a vast tundra of unpredictable prompts no farm can pre-script, and a passing score stays as scarce as saffron, filtering memorized templates. Minting the Nth identity costs the full fee again; checking one honest pass stays flat.
